canonical_vehicles.purpose: Single source of truth for all vehicles - one record per plate number globally

columns.plate_number: TEXT PRIMARY KEY - NZ vehicle plate
columns.homeless_confirmed_at: TIMESTAMPTZ - When admin confirmed homeless status
columns.homeless_notes: TEXT - Admin notes about homeless status
columns.is_flagged: BOOLEAN - Known problem vehicle requiring attention
columns.profile_photo: TEXT - Storage URL of primary vehicle photo
columns.total_hs_reports: INTEGER - Count of health & safety reports

triggers: Homeless status synced from observations via trigger_sync_homeless_to_canonical

vehicle_observations_v2.purpose: All vehicle sightings recorded by field officers - raw observation data with breach detection

columns.vehicle_make: TEXT - Snapshot at time of scan
columns.vehicle_model: TEXT - Snapshot at time of scan
columns.vehicle_year: INTEGER - Snapshot at time of scan
columns.vehicle_color: TEXT - Snapshot at time of scan
columns.self_contained: BOOLEAN - SC status at time of scan
columns.self_contained_expiry: DATE - SC expiry at time of scan
columns.photo: TEXT - Storage URL of scan photo
columns.photo_hash: TEXT - SHA256 hash for duplicate detection
columns.has_notes: BOOLEAN - Quick flag if notes exist
columns.has_homeless_claim: BOOLEAN - Officer claims vehicle is homeless
columns.homeless_claim_notes: TEXT - Officer notes about homeless claim
columns.breach_warning: BOOLEAN - Will breach if stays tonight
columns.breach_warning_reason: TEXT - Why at risk of breach
columns.compliance_snapshot: JSONB - Full compliance state at time of scan

vehicle_monthly_stays.purpose: Tracks overnight stays per vehicle per zone per calendar month for compliance calculation

columns.nights_stayed: INTEGER - Total nights in this month
columns.observation_ids: UUID[] - Array of observation IDs contributing to stays
columns.reset_at: TIMESTAMPTZ - When consecutive counter was last reset

triggers: Reset logic: consecutive_nights=0 if >24hrs between scans or new month

compliance_results.purpose: Historical compliance evaluation results linked to specific matrix versions for audit trail

columns.matrix_version: INTEGER - Matrix version at time of evaluation
columns.matrix_snapshot: JSONB - Full matrix state at evaluation time

compliance_results.note: Created by process-field-scan Edge Function after each observation

zone_compliance_matrix.purpose: Versioned compliance rules per zone - allows matrix changes with full audit history

columns.effective_from: TIMESTAMPTZ - When this version became active
columns.effective_to: TIMESTAMPTZ - When this version was superseded (NULL if current)
columns.nights_per_month: INTEGER - Max nights per calendar month
columns.homeless_exemption: BOOLEAN - Confirmed homeless exempt from limits

zone_compliance_matrix.note: New version created on every compliance rule change, old version gets effective_to timestamp

drift_events.purpose: Tracks compliance drift when matrix criteria change - identifies observations that changed status due to rule changes

columns.compliance_changed: INTEGER - Count that changed compliance status

breach_alerts.purpose: Active breaches requiring admin assignment to enforcement officers
triggers: Auto-created by trigger_create_breach_alert on vehicle_observations_v2 when is_breach=true

enforcement_actions.purpose: Enforcement jobs (warnings, notices, tow requests) with assignment workflow and completion tracking
triggers: trigger_auto_close_breach (closes linked breach_alerts when enforcement completed)

incidents.purpose: Court-ready incident reports with evidence integrity, multi-vehicle/person support, GPS verification

columns.homeless_status: TEXT - Homeless status at time of incident

zones.purpose: Geographic zones with compliance rules and boundary definitions

columns.name: TEXT - Zone name
columns.merged_into_zone_id: UUID FK → zones.id (if zone was merged)

zone_creation_suggestions.purpose: AI-suggested zones based on GPS clustering of observations without assigned zones

user_profiles.purpose: User accounts with roles, permissions, and multi-org support

patrols.purpose: Scheduled patrol shifts with officer assignments and geofencing

officer_activity_log.purpose: GPS ping tracking and officer activity timeline for welfare monitoring

officer_welfare_alerts.purpose: Automated welfare alerts when officers stop pinging or exceed inactivity thresholds

investigation_jobs.purpose: Field investigation assignments for homeless occupation, abandoned vehicles, unauthorized structures

photo_metadata.purpose: Tracks all uploaded photos with retention policies, hashing for deduplication, and court-ready flags

columns.photo_hash: TEXT - SHA256 hash for duplicate detection
columns.court_ready: BOOLEAN - Photo part of court-ready incident

triggers: trigger_set_scheduled_deletion (calculates deletion date based on retention policy)

audit_log.purpose: Comprehensive audit trail of all data changes with before/after values

import_history.purpose: Historical import tracking for bulk data imports

admin_recalculation_actions.purpose: Audit trail for compliance recalculation operations with REALTIME enabled for progress tracking

step_1_field_scan.description: Officer scans vehicle using PlateCapture component

input.plate_photo: Photo from camera with GPS metadata
input.zone_id: Auto-selected via GPS or manual selection

process: 1. Photo sent to Plate Recognizer API (recognize-plate Edge Function)
2. API returns: plate_number, confidence, vehicle attributes (make/model/color/year)
3. Photo uploaded to evidence bucket with hash calculation
4. VehicleDetailsPopup displays enriched data from canonical_vehicles
5. Officer reviews/edits details and clicks Check

step_2_observation_creation.description: process-field-scan Edge Function creates observation and evaluates compliance
process: 1. Query canonical_vehicles for existing vehicle data
2. If not exists, create canonical_vehicles record
3. If homeless_claim=true, sync to canonical_vehicles.homeless_status='claimed'
4. Calculate GPS distance from previous observation in same zone
5. If >15m apart in same zone, create new observation
6. If ≤15m apart, return duplicate_scan error
7. Get active zone_compliance_matrix for zone
8. Query vehicle_monthly_stays for current month
9. Evaluate compliance using calculate_vehicle_compliance()
10. Insert vehicle_observations_v2 with compliance results
11. Upsert vehicle_monthly_stays (increment nights if overnight)
12. Insert compliance_results record
13. If is_breach=true, trigger creates breach_alerts record
14. Update canonical_vehicles aggregates (total_observations, total_breaches, etc)

homeless_exemption.notes: Confirmed homeless vehicles exempt from all limits

evaluation: Query vehicle_monthly_stays for nights_stayed in current calendar month
IF day_of_week NOT IN allowed_days → BREACH (after_hours)

triggers: trigger_create_breach_alert on vehicle_observations_v2 AFTER INSERT/UPDATE WHEN is_breach=true
process: 1. Check if active breach_alerts already exists for plate+zone
2. If not exists, create breach_alerts record
3. Set status='pending' for admin assignment
4. Calculate severity (critical/high/medium based on excess nights)
5. Send push notification to admins via send-push-notification Edge Function

notification_logic.at_risk: Will breach if stays tonight (not a breach yet)

data_sources: canonical_vehicles (homeless status for FC Act tracking)

queries.compliance_rate: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_compliant=true) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM vehicle_observations_v2
queries.breach_count: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicle_observations_v2 WHERE is_breach=true
queries.homeless_compliance: SELECT cv.homeless_status, COUNT(*) FROM vehicle_observations_v2 vo JOIN canonical_vehicles cv ON vo.plate_number=cv.plate_number GROUP BY cv.homeless_status
queries.trend_over_time: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', recorded_at) AS day, COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_compliant=true) AS compliant FROM vehicle_observations_v2 GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

exports.pdf: Compliance trends chart + breach summary table + homeless FC Act exempt count
exports.csv: Raw observation data with compliance flags, breach types, homeless status

queries.scans_per_officer: SELECT recorded_by, COUNT(*) FROM vehicle_observations_v2 GROUP BY recorded_by
queries.enforcement_completion_rate: SELECT assigned_to, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE breach_status='completed') * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM enforcement_actions GROUP BY assigned_to
queries.patrol_completion_rate: SELECT assigned_to, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='completed') * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM patrols GROUP BY assigned_to
queries.activity_timeline: SELECT user_id, activity_type, recorded_at FROM officer_activity_log ORDER BY recorded_at DESC

queries.observations_per_zone: SELECT zone_id, COUNT(*) FROM vehicle_observations_v2 GROUP BY zone_id
queries.compliance_per_zone: SELECT zone_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_compliant=true) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM vehicle_observations_v2 GROUP BY zone_id
queries.breaches_per_zone: SELECT zone_id, COUNT(*) FROM vehicle_observations_v2 WHERE is_breach=true GROUP BY zone_id
queries.active_breaches_per_zone: SELECT zone_id, COUNT(*) FROM breach_alerts WHERE status IN ('pending','assigned') GROUP BY zone_id

heatmap_modes.activity: Cluster observations by GPS, color by density
heatmap_modes.compliance: Cluster observations, color by compliance rate (green=compliant, red=breach)
heatmap_modes.breaches: Show only breach locations, size by severity

data_sources: canonical_vehicles (homeless status, flagged status, vehicle details)
active_breaches_tab.query: SELECT DISTINCT ON (vo.plate_number, vo.zone_id) vo.plate_number, vo.zone_id, z.name AS zone_name, vo.breach_type, vo.breach_details, cv.homeless_status, cv.is_flagged, (SELECT breach_status FROM enforcement_actions WHERE plate_number=vo.plate_number AND zone_id=vo.zone_id AND breach_status IN ('active','assigned','in_progress') LIMIT 1) AS enforcement_status FROM vehicle_observations_v2 vo JOIN zones z ON vo.zone_id=z.id JOIN canonical_vehicles cv ON vo.plate_number=cv.plate_number WHERE vo.is_breach=true AND vo.recorded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY vo.plate_number, vo.zone_id, vo.recorded_at DESC

assigned_jobs_tab.query: SELECT ea.*, z.name AS zone_name, uo.first_name || ' ' || uo.last_name AS assigned_officer, ua.first_name || ' ' || ua.last_name AS assigned_by FROM enforcement_actions ea JOIN zones z ON ea.zone_id=z.id LEFT JOIN user_profiles uo ON ea.assigned_to=uo.id LEFT JOIN user_profiles ua ON ea.assigned_by=ua.id WHERE ea.breach_status IN ('active','assigned','in_progress') ORDER BY ea.assigned_at DESC NULLS LAST

completed_tab.query: SELECT ea.*, z.name AS zone_name, uo.first_name || ' ' || uo.last_name AS completed_officer FROM enforcement_actions ea JOIN zones z ON ea.zone_id=z.id LEFT JOIN user_profiles uo ON ea.completed_by=uo.id WHERE ea.breach_status IN ('completed','not_on_site','cancelled') ORDER BY ea.completed_at DESC LIMIT 100

flagged_tab.query: SELECT cv.*, uf.first_name || ' ' || uf.last_name AS flagged_by_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicle_observations_v2 WHERE plate_number=cv.plate_number AND recorded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') AS recent_sightings FROM canonical_vehicles cv LEFT JOIN user_profiles uf ON cv.flagged_by=uf.id WHERE cv.is_flagged=true ORDER BY cv.flagged_at DESC

homeless_tab.query: SELECT cv.*, uc.first_name || ' ' || uc.last_name AS confirmed_by_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicle_observations_v2 WHERE plate_number=cv.plate_number AND has_homeless_claim=true) AS claim_count FROM canonical_vehicles cv LEFT JOIN user_profiles uc ON cv.homeless_confirmed_by=uc.id WHERE cv.homeless_status IN ('claimed','confirmed') ORDER BY CASE cv.homeless_status WHEN 'claimed' THEN 1 WHEN 'confirmed' THEN 2 END, cv.homeless_confirmed_at DESC NULLS LAST
admin_actions: Confirm homeless status (sets homeless_status='confirmed', homeless_confirmed_by, homeless_confirmed_at)

live_tracking_tab.query: SELECT DISTINCT ON (oal.user_id) oal.*, up.first_name, up.last_name, up.phone, (SELECT status FROM patrols WHERE assigned_to=oal.user_id AND patrol_date=CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY checked_in_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS patrol_status FROM officer_activity_log oal JOIN user_profiles up ON oal.user_id=up.id WHERE oal.activity_type='gps_ping' AND oal.recorded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' ORDER BY oal.user_id, oal.recorded_at DESC
map_display: Officer location markers with name labels

active_alerts_tab.query: SELECT owa.*, uo.first_name AS officer_first_name, uo.last_name AS officer_last_name, ua.first_name || ' ' || ua.last_name AS acknowledged_by_name FROM officer_welfare_alerts owa JOIN user_profiles uo ON owa.officer_id=uo.id LEFT JOIN user_profiles ua ON owa.acknowledged_by=ua.id WHERE owa.status IN ('pending','acknowledged','escalated') ORDER BY owa.escalation_level DESC, owa.alert_sent_at DESC
alert_triggers: inactivity: No GPS ping for inactivity_warning_time minutes
no_gps: GPS disabled or no coordinates
prolonged_investigation: Investigation job exceeds expected duration

history_tab.query: SELECT owa.*, uo.first_name AS officer_first_name, uo.last_name AS officer_last_name, ur.first_name || ' ' || ur.last_name AS resolved_by_name FROM officer_welfare_alerts owa JOIN user_profiles uo ON owa.officer_id=uo.id LEFT JOIN user_profiles ur ON owa.resolved_by=ur.id WHERE owa.status='resolved' ORDER BY owa.resolved_at DESC LIMIT 100

vehicles_tab.query: SELECT cv.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicle_observations_v2 WHERE plate_number=cv.plate_number) AS total_obs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enforcement_actions WHERE plate_number=cv.plate_number) AS total_enf FROM canonical_vehicles cv ORDER BY cv.last_seen_at DESC

zones_tab.query: SELECT z.*, o.name AS org_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicle_observations_v2 WHERE zone_id=z.id) AS total_obs FROM zones z JOIN organizations o ON z.organization_id=o.id WHERE z.is_active=true ORDER BY z.name

compliance_matrix_tab.query: SELECT zcm.*, z.name AS zone_name, uc.first_name || ' ' || uc.last_name AS created_by_name FROM zone_compliance_matrix zcm JOIN zones z ON zcm.zone_id=z.id LEFT JOIN user_profiles uc ON zcm.created_by=uc.id WHERE zcm.effective_to IS NULL ORDER BY z.name, zcm.version DESC
versioning: Every rule change creates new version
management_actions: View drift events triggered by changes
